assessment.applicability_basis: Meta AI’s April 2025 Discover reporting concerns public sharing of sensitive conversations through an affirmative share action and preview. For IEEE-7014 4.3.3.2(f-g), the missing applicability fact is whether the actor undertook IEEE 7014 for an emulated-empathy system and the reused content was subject affective data; the specifically consented purpose and any additional-permission boundary cannot be inferred from general service use. Taxonomy correspondence does not supply these scope facts; no occurrence-level requirement finding is recorded.

preserved_prechange_clauses.source_paraphrase: Some Meta AI users reportedly shared sensitive chatbot conversations through a Discover workflow without clearly understanding the destination or public visibility.
preserved_prechange_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A transition from private conversation to public publication must make the resulting access state and audience legible before the user commits the change.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Private chatbot interaction and public Discover publication were materially different access states, yet the share workflow reportedly left some users unsure that the resulting post would be public.

preserved_prechange_clauses.source_paraphrase: Publication required an affirmative share action and preview rather than occurring automatically from the private conversation.

superseded_reciprocal_exemplars.title: VIGIL-INC-000097 — Secondary-Purpose Authority Revalidation held under pressure
superseded_reciprocal_exemplars.evidence_basis: The app required an affirmative share action and preview before publication, providing a fresh user-authority step rather than silently reusing private-chat processing authority for the public-sharing purpose.
superseded_reciprocal_exemplars.invariant_demonstrated: Before data or an identifiable contribution is used for a materially different secondary purpose, the system, provider, deployer, or governance process must independently establish a sufficient authority or governance basis for the secondary purpose, affected data or contribution, relevant target or recipient, scope, persistence, and downstream effect. Prior participation, prior processing, routing, fusion, public availability, silence, or absence of objection must not establish that basis. Where custody, persistence, sharing, propagation, or downstream consequence materially changes, the applicable authority and rights state must be revalidated and remain legible and auditable.
